mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repair_records ( id, mold_id, reporter_id, maintainer_id, verifier_id, repair_reason, repair_description, start_time, end_time, status, cost, notes, repair_approval_status, repair_approval_comment, repair_approver_id, repair_approval_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{moldId}, #{reporterId}, #{maintainerId}, #{verifierId}, #{repairReason}, #{repairDescription}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{cost}, #{notes}, #{repairApprovalStatus}, #{repairApprovalComment}, #{repairApproverId}, #{repairApprovalTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, mold_id AS moldId, reporter_id AS reporterId, maintainer_id AS maintainerId, verifier_id AS verifierId, repair_reason AS repairReason, repair_description AS repairDescription, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, status, cost, notes, repair_approval_status AS repairApprovalStatus, repair_approval_comment AS repairApprovalComment, repair_approver_id AS repairApproverId, repair_approval_time AS repairApprovalTime FROM repair_records WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.mold_id, m.mold_code, m.name AS mold_name, m.category AS mold_category, r.reporter_id, ur.real_name AS reporter_name, r.maintainer_id, um.real_name AS maintainer_name, r.verifier_id, uv.real_name AS verifier_name, r.repair_reason, r.repair_description, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.status, r.cost, r.notes, r.repair_approval_status, r.repair_approval_comment, r.repair_approver_id, r.repair_approval_time, r.created_at FROM repair_records r LEFT JOIN molds m ON r.mold_id = m.id LEFT JOIN users ur ON r.reporter_id = ur.id LEFT JOIN users um ON r.maintainer_id = um.id LEFT JOIN users uv ON r.verifier_id = uv.id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.mold_id, m.mold_code, m.name AS mold_name, m.category AS mold_category, r.reporter_id, ur.real_name AS reporter_name, r.maintainer_id, um.real_name AS maintainer_name, r.verifier_id, uv.real_name AS verifier_name, r.repair_reason, r.repair_description, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.status, r.cost, r.notes, r.repair_approval_status, r.repair_approval_comment, r.repair_approver_id, r.repair_approval_time, r.created_at FROM repair_records r LEFT JOIN molds m ON r.mold_id = m.id LEFT JOIN users ur ON r.reporter_id = ur.id LEFT JOIN users um ON r.maintainer_id = um.id LEFT JOIN users uv ON r.verifier_id = uv.id WHERE r.mold_id = #{moldId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM repair_records WHERE mold_id = #{moldId} AND start_time >= #{since}
